integrity: The proof gives an exact finite-field quantitative specialization and monomial-orbit spectrum; direct finite-field enumerations check only finitely many parameters. All nilpotent instances have one regular Jordan block. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to nonzero loops plus one directed Hamiltonian cycle; no other nonzero entries. The 2009 existence characterization is credited as prior work. No assertion of exhaustive bibliographic priority or of arbitrary-pattern classification.
title: Exact nilpotent realization counts and monomial orbit spectra for looped directed cycles
